charts.title: TOI-2449 b: orbits around TOI-2449
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2449's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2449 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.
